text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So, long story short, my legs are in a
condition
where they may fail at any
given moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shortly after the Kikuka Sho, Agnes
Tachyon
abruptly enters my office with
this announcement.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shocked, I shoot up from my chair like a
rocket.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
These legs of mine possess both
natural-born
speed and a fatal fragility,
you see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh! Just look at your shock. I was
correct in
withholding this information
until now.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The secret that I've been keeping. I gave
you my
word. If things began going well,
I would divulge
everything.
choice_data_list: What are you talking about all of ...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You've been quite a good guinea pig, so
I
thought to reward you, scant as it may
be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now with the surprises out of the way,
she gets herself settled in. The setting
sun's light enters
the room and casts a
soft glow across her face.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You're well aware of my profound
fascination
towards the Umamusume
body.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A body no different from the human
body, yet boasts a physical capacity
several times higher... Imagine just how
far such a sublime mechanism
can go...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In my youth, I was convinced this grand
pursuit of
mine was inevitable. Actually...
the sentiment still
holds true.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In addition, as I'm a talented runner, I
also
intended to push myself beyond the
limit with my
own two legs.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Though, as I feared... realizing this
dream has
become slightly problematic
because of that
aforementioned reason.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Figuratively speaking, my engine is
sound, but my structural frame flimsy.
Any slight overexertion
poses a great
risk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's referring to her decisions to back
out from races. They always came so
suddenly that I
thought they were on
impulse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But the real reason was because of her
physical
condition.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well... it is what it is.
It's the reason why I've been
conducting two separate
studies, Plan A and Plan
B.
choice_data_list: To think there was a secret like t...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Plan A aims to reach the limits of speed
by
strengthening my own legs with the
help of
various experiments.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, Plan B foregoes the 
involvement of myself and seeks to
reach the limits of speed by way of
proxy. That is, with the help of other
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I have been conducting each study 
simultaneously. It was in the middle of
this that
you decided to become my
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You put your faith in me. You were so
keen when
you proposed the idea of
entering the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if recalling a fond memory, Agnes
Tachyon
closes her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I know you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I know you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you're free to selfishly pin your
hopes on
me. I wouldn't deny you that.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In truth, I too began to see myself
running in the
Classics. However, facts
are facts.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Competing at the Satsuki Sho, I
realized... that
my legs simply can't
endure against such fierce
competition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I remember after the Satsuki Sho, when we
started planning ahead, she was
insistent on
remaining uncommitted to
our agenda.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The reasoning behind Agnes Tachyon's
behavior
begins coming to light, piece
by piece.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Progress for Plan A wasn't coming along
too well.
I couldn't see myself being
prepared for the peak
of this period.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Thus, I resorted to Plan B.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Plan B, in other words, the realization of
her
dream with the aid of an
Umamusume in her
stead...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that mean that she'll stop
racing?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Expecting my legs to fail, I began testing

concoctions that would be used on
another racer.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This is also why I had decided to run in
the Gekkei Hai. I simply couldn't ignore
such a grand
opportunity for data
collection.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It was then, however, when you
unwittingly said
to me...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That you wanted to go beyond the limit
together,
or something to that effect.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
It seems I'm the type with an affinity to
the
eccentric.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
So long as the potential isn't zero,
I can't
quit,
now can I?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now I finally understand what she
meant.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
An acute observation. The impulse to
bet on Plan
A prevailed against my
better judgment.
choice_data_list: So that's why she withdrew after t...
So that's why you withdrew after t...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Rather, it'd be more fitting to say that
you
rekindled my smoldering dreams.
You're a real
troublemaker, you know.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But in the end... it is still my
decision—my fatal
attraction to this
thing called potential.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Without my knowing, it ate away at me
from the
inside, leaving me vulnerable
and brittle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her voice diminished almost to a
whisper, she lets
out a quiet sigh.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Though it was because of that I finally
found my
resolve—to continue Plan A
until the end.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
My running in the Gekkei Hai was only
for the chance to collect data with
expectations that my
legs might fail. So,
I withdrew.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I then dedicated myself fully to my
research, with
time as my main enemy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
But during summer camp, I began to see
a light at
the end of the tunnel. I felt my
body gaining the
capacity to endure!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was a day when she mentioned testing
her hypothesis for Plan A. That's right...
It was the
first time in a while she had
really exerted herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The pieces are all coming together. I'm
finally
beginning to understand the truth
of Agnes
Tachyon's circumstances.
choice_data_list: (And on that day, it was undeniabl...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And that is why I could commit to

participating in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Well, she sure threw me for a loop with
her
distant attitude.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I realized when I finished the Kikuka Sho
that I
could survive the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Which is why today, as an exception, I
can make
this promise.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As compensation for coming along this
journey
beyond limits, I'll reward you a
few victories.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All right, then, let's hear your plans for
my senior
year races. I'm all ears.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days earlier you wouldn't be able to
convince me she'd turn this new leaf.
My face
turning hot, I feel a lump
forming in my throat.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Oh, don't cry, guinea pig!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
This is the beginning of my redemption
arc—you
should be smiling.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Heh-heh. You always were the
emotional type.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me, this is the perfect
time to
measure your stress levels.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You see, I have a deep interest in
emotions at the moment. Come here, let
me borrow your finger so
I can read your
heart rate.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't "huh" me! Didn't you become my
trainer in
order to work as my guinea
pig?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes reflect the light of the setting
sun,
revealing a kind of innocence
behind their
enigmatic veneer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I expect our goal races won't change
again
anytime soon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The soonest race is a medium G1, the
Osaka Hai.
With our sights firmly set, it's
time to bring home
the trophy!
